description: 5-digit ZIP code (2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area)

Flood-defence assumption for future scenarios: fixed-crest (defences keep today's crest height; default) or raised-crest (defences are raised with the hazard and keep their design standard). Present-climate rows are identical in both
Scenario-year identifier: baseline, ssp245_2030, ssp245_2060, ssp585_2030, ssp585_2060
Emission scenario: present, ssp245, ssp585
Year for which damage is computed (2020 present climate, 2030, 2060)
Flood type: fluvial, pluvial, coastal, combined (max depth across flood types)
State FIPS code of the majority of the ZIP's residential buildings
Residential structures (Hazus RES1, RES2, RES3A-F) in the ZIP
Housing units in those structures
Full replacement cost of residential structures
Full replacement cost of contents
Structures + contents full replacement cost
Depreciated structure value (NSI)
Night-time population in residential structures (NSI)
Residential buildings behind a flood defence for river or coastal flooding (FEMA levee zone, USACE NLD leveed area, or implicit coastal defence)

Expected number of residential buildings in the SFHA built after the community's first flood map (post-FIRM) and therefore elevated to the base flood elevation (sum of building probabilities, NFIP policies 2019)
Average annual loss: expected loss per year (structure + contents)
AAL divided by value_total_usd
Conditional loss when each building experiences its 1-in-100-year flood (sum over the ZIP)
l100_usd divided by value_total_usd
Conditional loss when each building experiences its 1-in-1,000-year flood (sum over the ZIP)
l1000_usd divided by value_total_usd
Residential buildings with flood depth > 0 in the 1-in-100-year event
n_bldg_flooded_100yr divided by n_res_buildings
Exposure dataset version
Price level of monetary values
Model / product version
